snippet.title: Ding Dong DEAD - Coming Friday the 13th!
snippet.description:
A slasher horror game where your decisions matter. Babysit Rex, avoid the ripper, give in to your dark side? The choices are yours!
Dare to babysit AGAIN?

Jordan King's DING DONG DEAD

Coming to patreon: http://patreon.com/puppetcombo
